_source: GroBez (12.6K subs) 'Who Kill*d Q Mobile? The Story of Pakistan's Lost Mobile King', 519K views in 2 months; Hindi/Urdu narration. Watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-19: frames 0-55 s every 2-10 s, then 150/260/380/490 s; word count from YouTube's transcript panel (1,389 words over 488 s, about 170 a minute). Partly a talking head (the host on camera) with some AI-looking scenes, so not our kind: sampled lightly per the owner's speed note, no sound probe. Our own descriptions.

lines.gist: Asks who ruined the brand, then whether anyone remembers it.
Today's kids don't even know its name.
Once it held most of the market and set a sales record.
Celebrity adverts and model names everywhere.
Every collapse has a culprit; guess who it was here.
Founder's story, rise, smuggling and tax trouble, rivals, decline.

whyItWorks: A whodunit title for a brand the audience owned as kids: nostalgia plus a mystery.
The first 50 s stack rank, a record and celebrity ads before promising the culprit.
Cheap but fast: host to camera cut with logos, ads and newspaper clippings every few seconds.
